datasets.purpose: Predict whether an adult individual annual income in the US exceeds $50,000 based on census demographic, educational, and employment variables.

columns.name: AGEP
columns.description: Individual age in completed years at the time of the census.
columns.reason: Classic demographic quasi-identifier (Sweeney, 2002); must be generalized into age brackets for k-anonymity.

columns.name: COW
columns.description: Class of worker (private sector, government employee, self-employed, unpaid family worker).
columns.reason: Broad employment category with low individual re-identification risk.

columns.name: SCHL
columns.description: Highest level of formal educational attainment completed by the individual.
columns.reason: Socioeconomic quasi-identifier that reduces equivalence class sizes when combined with age, sex, and region.

columns.name: MAR
columns.description: Marital status of the individual (married, widowed, divorced, separated, never married).
columns.reason: Classic demographic quasi-identifier frequently used in record linkage attacks.

columns.name: OCCP
columns.description: Detailed census occupation code of the worker.
columns.reason: High-cardinality occupational identifier that singles out rare professionals in a geographic area.

columns.name: POBP
columns.description: Detailed place of birth code (US state or foreign country of origin).
columns.reason: Geographic origin is a strong quasi-identifier and may reveal national or ethnic origin.

columns.name: RELP
columns.description: Relationship of the individual to the household reference person.
columns.reason: General intra-household structural relationship attribute.

columns.name: WKHP
columns.description: Usual number of hours worked per week during the past 12 months.
columns.reason: Operational labor variable without direct identifying or sensitive nature.

columns.name: SEX
columns.description: Biological sex of the individual (Male / Female).
columns.reason: Basic quasi-identifier present in the classic re-identification triad (sex, age, postal code).

columns.name: RAC1P
columns.description: Detailed census racial group self-declaration code (White, Black, Asian, Indigenous, etc.).
columns.reason: Sensitive personal data concerning racial or ethnic origin (GDPR Art. 9 / LGPD Art. 5 II).

columns.name: PINCP_gt_50k
columns.description: Binary indicator of whether annual total personal income exceeds $50,000.
columns.reason: Sensitive financial attribute indicating personal income threshold.

datasets.purpose: Diagnose the presence and severity of coronary artery disease in patients using clinical examinations, blood pressure, cholesterol, and electrocardiogram.

columns.name: sex

columns.reason: Fundamental demographic quasi-identifier.

columns.name: cp

columns.reason: Clinical cardiology symptom protected by medical privacy (HIPAA / GDPR Art. 9).

columns.description: Resting blood pressure (in mm Hg) upon hospital admission.

columns.name: chol

columns.reason: Clinical laboratory test result (sensitive health data).

columns.name: fbs
columns.description: Fasting blood sugar > 120 mg/dl indicator.
columns.reason: Laboratory indicator of diabetes and hyperglycemia (sensitive medical data).

columns.name: restecg

columns.reason: Confidential cardiologic diagnostic report.

columns.name: thalach

columns.reason: Physiological measure obtained during medical diagnostic test.

columns.name: exang
columns.description: Exercise induced angina indicator.
columns.reason: Symptomatic clinical condition of myocardial ischemia.

columns.name: oldpeak
columns.description: ST depression induced by exercise relative to rest.
columns.reason: Diagnostic electrocardiographic parameter.

columns.name: slope
columns.description: Slope of the peak exercise ST segment.
columns.reason: Clinical cardiology exam parameter.

columns.name: ca
columns.description: Number of major vessels (0 to 3) colored by fluoroscopy.
columns.reason: Invasive vascular imaging diagnostic result.

columns.name: thal
columns.description: Thallium scintigraphy result (normal, fixed defect, reversible defect).
columns.reason: Sensitive hematologic/cardiovascular diagnosis.

columns.name: num
columns.description: Angiographic diagnosis of heart disease (0 = healthy, 1 to 4 = degree of coronary blockage).
columns.reason: Definitive medical diagnosis of cardiac pathology (HIPAA / GDPR Art. 9).

columns.name: Attribute17

columns.reason: Unique clinical episode identifier (HIPAA Safe Harbor mandates removal of account numbers).

columns.reason: Direct medical record identifier; requires suppression or cryptographic hashing.

columns.reason: Demographic quasi-identifier.

columns.name: age

columns.name: weight

columns.reason: Administrative hospital flow code.

columns.name: discharge_disposition_id

columns.reason: Specific outcomes (such as death or psychiatric transfer) act as linkage quasi-identifiers.

columns.name: admission_source_id

columns.name: time_in_hospital

columns.name: num_procedures

columns.name: num_medications
columns.description: Number of distinct medications administered during the stay.

columns.reason: Comorbidity count without specifying exact ICD codes.

columns.name: diag_1

columns.name: diag_2

columns.name: diabetesMed

columns.reason: Confirms active drug therapy for a chronic disease.

columns.name: readmitted

datasets.purpose: Evaluate the actuarial criminal recidivism risk score (COMPAS) and criminal history of defendants arrested in Broward County, Florida.

columns.name: last

columns.reason: Fundamental demographic quasi-identifier.

columns.name: age
columns.description: Individual age in completed years.

columns.name: race

columns.name: juv_misd_count

columns.name: decile_score
